content: Awayauwedo
Yau Paulo, Yeisu Besinana yana tauyewasa teya, nigele tomowa yadi vesinuwaena, na hesi Yeisu yana vesinuwaena, yo hinage Tamada Yaubada. Ibom Yeisu mwalowoiyena i'abiye towolouyoi.
Na tahidao baidaguwao yami leta avetamalenawa omiu tautapwalolo, boda ehebo ehebo tupwa Galetiya holanai ammiyamiya.
Tamada Yaubada yo yada Bada Yeisu Besinana yadi ve'i'ilaena ammiya namwanamwa.
Wuwuna Tamada Yaubada yana nuwatuwu teina dova, ainaena Yeisu ibom italam ta imwalowoi yada pwanoli vehabadi, eeta ihaguigita teina bale'u yababana yana wahiyalaena,
teina vehabana Yaubada ainai tawalowalo vetuvehae, nigele yana aba'ovi. Moiha.
Wasa namwanamwana ehebo ta'i

Abanuwapwanopwano teina aliguwai, wuwuna Yaubada mugai ivesinuwaigomiu ta ebe Besinana ainaena ve'i'ila amlobai, yo wasana namwanamwana amyemidiyei. Na mwayamwayauwena teina hauga amta'wata'wataena'o, na wasa vagana amyemidiyeine.

Wasa namwanamwana ehebo ta'i, na nigele teya hinage wasa iyamiyamiya, na hesi tupwadi tomowa bada hivelau pwanopwanogomiu'o, wuwuna nuwanuwadi yo Besinana wasana himwau gwaipile ta ainaena hi'oya'oyamaegomiu.

Besinana wasana mugai ambenaleine neta moihana, eeta havena teya yaiya vali wasa imohemohegomiu. Ai yo tausagenawasa galewaena nigele howahowana wasa vagana ayamohegomiu. Na ebe yaiya wasa namwanamwana imwau gwaipile ta vali wasa iyemahalava, vitai mata ilobai Yaubada ainaena.
Bada mugai awalo mahalava'o alimiyai, na teina hinage yawalo mahalavauyo neta ebe yaiya vali wasa imohegomiu, yababana mata ilobai Yaubada ainaena.

Vedova, tomowadine adi walo vetuvehae vehabana yanuwanuwatuwu, bo nuwana Yaubada ana walo vetuvehae? Wuwuna ebe tomowa yadi nuwatuwu yapaipaihowai, nigele howahowagu ta Besinana vehabana yavetaupaihowa.
Paulo yana nuwabui
Tahiguwao, amnuwatuwu avivini neta wasa namwanamwana yawalowalo mahalavae, nigele tomowa aidiyena.
Wasane nigele tomowa yadi walomahalavao yo yadi ve'itao aidiyena, na hesi Yeisu Besinana yana ve'itao aliguwai ainaena.
Na yagu mumuga mugamugaina, haugana taumiya Yudeya yadi boda holanai yamiyamiya, neta ambenalena'o, ebeha Yaubada yana bodao ya'abi'abiye muyadi na nuwanuwagu yo yamutudi.
Ainaena agu yasowone taumiya Yudeya holanai yawahiyala gabaedi, wuwuna tubudao yadi mumuga vehabana ya'ai'aipate wahiyala na agu yasoyasowowa yadi aipate tupwana ta'i.
Haugana nigele hiyalabahigau, na mugai Yaubada yana ve'i'ilaena bada ivesinuwagau'o,
ta ibom yana nuwatuwena natuna aliguwai ive'itaei, ta yavetauyewasa vehabana nigele Yudeya aidiyai. Ainaena nigele yayalaulau tomowa aidiyai habi panivila wasa teina vehabana.
Nigele yayalau Yelusalem Besinana ana tauyewasa mugai aidiyai, na hesi yalau Alebiya, ta nemai yamiyamiya ana higa yalau gwaipilema Damasiko.
Mulitai bolimai tonuga tuluhadiyai yahae Yelusalem, Pita yatau bo'eyei, na nemai baidagu ahubena 15 amiyamiya.
Na Yeisu ana tauyewasa bahudi nigele yaya'itadi. Neta bada Yemesa, ibom yada Bada tahina.
Yagu walo teina Tamada mehenai yalelediwa nigele teya hinage oyama.
I'ovi na Yelusalem yalaugabaei ta yalau Siliya yo Silisiya yadi tupwa ainai.
Na haugana yamiyamiya aidiyai Besinana yana bodao Yudeya tupwanao aidiyai nigele agu oleya hiyahanapui.
Bada wasagu hibenalena'o ebeha ‘Ibom mugai iyeyemuyagitawa, na hesi bada inuwabui'o, ta wasa namwanamwana mugai ilaulaugagayoweiwa hauga teina iguguguyaei.’
Ainaena Yaubada hiwalo vetuvehaeyei yagu nuwabui vehabana.
